svg.title: Public schools within 30 minutes on foot and by public transport, Recife metropolitan region
svg.desc: Two maps of the conurbation of Recife with the cells of a grid coloured by the number of public schools reached within 30 minutes at the morning peak: on the left walking, on the right walking plus public transport. On foot the average resident of the region reaches 13 schools; with buses, metro and VLT 24, and the cells along the corridors that lead to the centre of Recife reach 80 or more.

g.text: Recife metropolitan region: 1,203 public schools (INEP) counted from each of 13,096 inhabited
cells; departures 07:00–07:59 on Tuesday 10 November 2026 (median). The average resident
reaches 13 on foot and 24 with buses, metro and VLT; within 45 minutes, 26 and 79. Blank: none,
Public schools within 30 minutes, on foot and with public transport

Transporte Metropolitano, GTFS v2026.10.26. Boundaries and population: IBGE, Censo 2022. Schools: INEP, Catálogo de
